summary: Defines a YANG data model for managing radio link interfaces in a microwave or millimeter wave node, and for their connection to packet (typically Ethernet) interfaces. Interface protection is split into a separate generic model so it can be reused for other interface types. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: The settings sheet for a radio dish that sends data through the air from tower to tower, written in a form software can read and change.

questions: yang model for microwave radio link
